title: Ichthyosis
summary: Ichthyosis, with extensive skin lesions (joint motion impairment in multiple extremities, palms, or soles/perineum/inguinal) that persist for at least 3 months despite continuing treatment as prescribed.

children.criterion: Ichthyosis diagnosis, with extensive skin lesions persisting for at least 3 months despite continuing treatment as prescribed
Extensive skin lesions (see 8.00C1) — any one of: joint-motion limitation in multiple extremities, palmar lesions limiting fine/gross motor, or sole/perineum/inguinal lesions limiting ambulation
Skin lesions that interfere with the motion of joints and very seriously limit use of more than one extremity (two upper, two lower, or one upper and one lower)
Skin lesions on the palms of both hands that very seriously limit fine and gross motor movements
Skin lesions on the soles of both feet, the perineum, or both inguinal areas that very seriously limit ambulation
